A01.design: Take 6 interventions with published mouse lifespan effect sizes. Test each in short-term human panels (n=60/arm): inflammation composite, GrimAge2, VO2max, muscle biopsy mitochondrial respiration. Pre-register rank-correlation analysis.
endpoints: Spearman rho: mouse lifespan Δ vs human biomarker Δ

A02.design: Systemic senolytic vs genetic clearance in aged mice with single-cell census of cleared populations across 12 tissues. Flag cleared clusters enriched for tissue-resident macrophages, progenitors, or wound-healing fibroblasts.
endpoints: Fraction of cleared cells that are non-senescent by transcriptome

A03.design: Two-sample MR: genetic instruments for NAD+ synthesis capacity vs 8 aging outcomes in UK Biobank. Follow with a 12-month NR 'clamp' RCT (n=200) measuring whether raising NAD+ moves hard functional endpoints, not just NAD+ levels.
endpoints: Δ 6-min walk, Δ muscle respiration at matched NAD+ rise

A04.design: Assemble all published interventions with both clock Δ and lifespan Δ (target n≥40). Fit clock-Δ→lifespan-Δ transfer function. Then run a prospective mouse trial of 3 clock-decelerating interventions measuring actual lifespan.
endpoints: R² of clock Δ predicting lifespan Δ

A05.design: 2-year RCT of intermittent everolimus (n=400, 65+): composite primary of infection rate, HbA1c trajectory, and vaccine response vs epigenetic-age and inflammation benefit. Pre-specified harm–benefit tradeoff rule.
endpoints: Net clinical benefit score (benefits minus harms)

A06.design: Deep-phenotype 100 humans on 18-month 15% CR (transcriptome, metabolome, proteome across 3 tissues) and align pathway-level changes against 6 rodent CR datasets. Quantify conserved vs divergent modules.
endpoints: Fraction of rodent CR pathway modules conserved in humans

A07.design: Paired measurement in aged tissues: p16/SA-β-gal staining vs single-cell transcriptomic senescence signature vs functional SASP secretion. Compute positive predictive value of each classical marker per tissue.
endpoints: PPV of p16+ for transcriptomic senescence, by tissue

A08.design: Systematic OSK pulse matrix (4 durations × 4 doses × 3 delivery routes) in aged wild-type mice, 18-month follow-up: teratoma screen, pluripotency gene panel, tumor incidence vs rejuvenation readouts.
endpoints: Maximum rejuvenation dose with zero teratomas at 18 mo

A09.design: Extract paired healthspan/lifespan outcomes from 60 published intervention studies; estimate coupling coefficient and its moderators (sex, strain, intervention class). Prospectively test 4 'healthspan-only' interventions for lifespan.

A10.design: Test programmatic predictions: (1) aging trajectories should be predictable from early-life state; (2) program blockade should compress morbidity. Compare predictive accuracy of programmatic vs damage-accumulation models on longitudinal cohorts.
endpoints: Out-of-sample trajectory prediction, program vs damage models

A11.design: Apply human-trained and mouse-trained clocks to both species' methylation data; test whether orthologous-CpG clocks rank interventions concordantly across 10 shared interventions.

A12.design: Emulate a target trial in 2M-record EHR with cloning/censoring/weighting; negative-control outcomes; then drug-target MR for metformin targets (AMPK pathway instruments) vs mortality.
endpoints: Emulated trial HR with full confounding control

A13.design: Inducible, tissue-specific mitochondrial rescue in aged mice; time-series multi-omics to test whether senescence, epigenetic, and proteostasis hallmarks normalize downstream — with temporal precedence analysis.
endpoints: Hallmarks normalized per unit mito rescue

A14.design: Single senolytic course in aged mice; track function and senescent-cell re-accumulation monthly for 12 months to estimate benefit half-life. Parallel human pilot with 12-month functional follow-up after one course.

A15.design: Four-arm trial: ad-lib, chronic 20% CR, periodic FMD, time-restricted feeding — matched for weight loss. Compare pathway activation (mTOR, AMPK, IGF-1, autophagy flux) and functional outcomes.
endpoints: Pathway-activation cosine similarity FMD vs CR
Functional outcomes at matched weight loss
